using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Http;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Utils;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.Services;

public class PackageVersionCheckerService : ITransientDependency
{
    private readonly CliHttpClientFactory _cliHttpClientFactory;
    public ILogger<PackageVersionCheckerService> Logger { get; set; }

    public PackageVersionCheckerService(CliHttpClientFactory cliHttpClientFactory)
    {
        _cliHttpClientFactory = cliHttpClientFactory;
        Logger = NullLogger<PackageVersionCheckerService>.Instance;
    }

    public async Task<string> GetLatestPreviewVersionAsync()
    {
        var client = _cliHttpClientFactory.CreateClient(false);
        var response = await client.GetAsync("https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json");

        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            Logger.LogError("Couldn't retrieve the latest preview version.");
            return null;
        }

        var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        var versions = JObject.Parse(json)["versions"];

        if (versions == null)
        {
            Logger.LogError("Couldn't retrieve the latest preview version.");
            return null;
        }

        var latestPreviewVersion = versions
            .Where(v => v["version"].ToString().Contains("preview"))
            .OrderByDescending(v => v["version"])
            .Select(v => v["version"].ToString())
            .FirstOrDefault();

        return latestPreviewVersion;
    }
}

    public async Task InstallSuiteAsync_LogsLatestPreviewVersion()

        var nuGetIndexUrlServiceMock = new Mock<AbpNuGetIndexUrlService>();

        var cliHttpClientFactoryMock = new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>();
        var suiteAppSettingsServiceMock = new Mock<SuiteAppSettingsService>();
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();

        var suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
            nuGetIndexUrlServiceMock.Object,
            packageVersionCheckerServiceMock.Object,
            cmdHelperMock.Object,
            authServiceMock.Object,
            cliHttpClientFactoryMock.Object,
            suiteAppSettingsServiceMock.Object
        )
        {
            Logger = loggerMock.Object
        };

        var commandLineArgs = new CommandLineArgs
        {
            Options = new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, string>
            {
                { "preview", "true" }
            }
        };

        nuGetIndexUrlServiceMock.Setup(x => x.GetAsync()).ReturnsAsync("https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json");
        packageVersionCheckerServiceMock.Setup(x => x.GetLatestPreviewVersionAsync()).ReturnsAsync("1.0.0-preview");

        // Act
        await suiteCommand.InstallSuiteAsync(null, true);

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogInformation("Latest preview version is 1.0.0-preview"),
            Times.Once
        );
    }
}
